verdict.rationale: The documented Analytics API uses a versioned path (`GET /v2/analytics/computer/usage`), and an OpenAPI spec is published, so there is some evidence of API versioning. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, and the core Computer MCP endpoint (`/rest/computer/mcp`) carries no version marker. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy or sunset timelines, versioning of the MCP/Computer task API, a changelog or version-lifecycle docs, and independent corroboration.
